title: Maximum AND Sum of Array
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer numSlots where 2 * numSlots >= length of nums, place all nums into numSlots slots numbered 1 to numSlots such that each slot contains at most two numbers.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer numSlots where 2 * numSlots >= length of nums, place all nums into numSlots slots numbered 1 to numSlots such that each slot contains at most two numbers. Calculate the AND sum by bitwise ANDing each number with its slot number and summing the results. Find the maximum possible AND sum.
constraints: Slots are numbered 1 through num_slots and each holds at most two numbers.
Every number must be assigned to one slot.
Maximize the sum of nums[i] bitwise-AND its assigned slot number.
hints: Each slot occupancy has three states: zero, one, or two numbers.
Encode all occupancies as a base-three integer and memoize by number index and state.
Try every slot whose ternary digit is below two, add the AND contribution, and recurse after increasing that digit.
The recurrence enumerates every capacity-valid assignment exactly by its sequence of slot choices and selects the greatest total.
editorial: The recurrence enumerates every capacity-valid assignment exactly by its sequence of slot choices and selects the greatest total.

tests.explanation: A capacity-respecting assignment can collect AND contributions totaling 9, which is optimal.
With enough slots, selecting useful slot bits for each number produces the optimum 24.
